content.overview: Governance duties are spread across board composition (s. 149), committees (ss 177-178), directors' duties (s. 166), accounts and audit (Chapter X), and CSR (s. 135), with LODR for listed companies.
content.glance: Governance duties are spread across board composition (s. 149), committees (ss 177-178), directors' duties (s. 166), accounts and audit (Chapter X), and CSR (s. 135), with LODR for listed companies.
content.study: Treat the Act as the baseline and LODR as additional for listed entities. Independent directors, audit committee, vigil mechanism, related-party approval and board evaluation are the core levers. Governance guidance that contradicts a section is not law.
